sql:
SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.dk_salary_week` WHERE season=2026 AND week=1) AS salary_w1,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.dk_salary_week` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS salary_w2,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT gsis_id,season,week FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.dk_salary_week` GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS salary_duplicates,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT gsis_id,season,week FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_inference` GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS inference_duplicates,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT gsis_id,season,week FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_training` GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS training_duplicates,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_inference` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS upcoming,
      (SELECT COUNTIF(games_played_prior>0) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_inference` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS prior_game,
      (SELECT COUNTIF(snap_share_l4 IS NOT NULL) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_inference` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS prior_snap,
      (SELECT MAX(games_played_prior) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_inference` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2) AS max_prior,
      (SELECT COUNTIF(games_played_prior>0) FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_usage` WHERE season=2026 AND week=1) AS future_support
